items.summary: Schedule axis explored; constant beat linear-decay by ~+1pp (Phase N 0.368 vs Phase L 0.356) but signal-set is the binding constraint. Next move: signal-mix change (drop weak signals; add value-head-delta tempo signal per scoping notes option (1)).

Add a 6th reward shaping signal: per-step value-head probability delta (model's own assessment of own-win probability between consecutive states). Phase N established the constant-shape schedule as winning over linear-decay; this is the next single-axis move — signal-set change. Recommended over the alternative (drop low-attribution + scale survivors) because it taps a different information source (model's own probabilistic assessment) rather than just hand-engineered observation deltas.
